notes: archive.org upload by a third party; in copyright; local research use. Ingested 2026-10-09 (fetch/import_meal_eliacik.py) from the OCR text of the three mushaf-ordered volumes: 6236/6236 ayat covered; 69 places where the OCR lost a verse number (their text sits in the unit before, tied there: see ingestion.number_lost_in_ocr_text_tied_to_previous_unit); 0 verses with no text at all. Some verses are printed as groups («1/2-», «14-15-»), kept as a..a_end (overlapping groups such as 18:1-2 and 18:2-3 are both kept). Footnotes (Eliaçık's commentary) are kept whole; 30 are placed by their marker, the others are tied to the verses of their page. OCR noise from the Arabic column was removed from verse text and kept in each segment's ocr_noise_removed; some noise remains inside lines.
